events.fact: Xero uses OAuth 2.0 with authorization code grant and supports PKCE (code_challenge_methods_supported includes S256).
Xero developer portal is located at developer.xero.com/app/manage.
Xero authorization endpoint is https://login.xero.com/identity/connect/authorize and token endpoint is https://identity.xero.com/connect/token.

Xero developer pricing has five tiers: Starter (5 connections, free, requires certification), Core (50 connections, $35 AUD/month, requires certification and payment method), Plus (1,000 connections, $245 AUD/month), Advanced (10,000 connections, $1445 AUD/month), and Enterprise (unlimited connections, custom pricing).
Xero API rate limits per connection are: 5 concurrent calls, 60 calls per minute, and 5000 calls per day (Starter has 1000 calls per day). App-wide limit is 10,000 calls per minute.

events.query: "Xero" OAuth scopes list accounting offline_access openid

events.fact: Xero requires a refresh token via the offline_access scope for ongoing access and app certification; openid profile email are used for user identity.

Xero has transitioned from broad scopes (like accounting.transactions) to granular scopes (e.g. accounting.invoices, accounting.payments, accounting.banktransactions, accounting.manualjournals), with full migration required by September 13, 2027.
Xero redirect URIs must be absolute URIs without wildcards, and up to 50 unique redirect URIs can be registered per application.

Certified Xero App Partners must onboard at least 10 beta/active customers using the integration with non-demo companies, undergo security assessments (initial and annual), and meet strict branding and connection flow requirements.
Xero data obtained from APIs may not be used to train AI/ML models under updated developer terms.
Xero access tokens expire after 30 minutes (1800 seconds), and refresh tokens are valid for 60 days (with a rolling window on each successful refresh).

Xero pricing and policy updates introduced new tiered developer plans (Starter, Core, Plus, Advanced, Enterprise) effective March 2, 2026, alongside strict restrictions prohibiting the use of API-retrieved data for training AI/ML models.
